record_reference_graph.evidence_record_rule: Create and content-address the immutable evidence record before creating the separate Stage A admission record.
record_reference_graph.forbidden_record_reference: CANONICAL_FIELD_MAPPING_EVIDENCE -> STAGE_A_ADMISSION_RECORD (evidence must not reference the later Stage A record)
record_reference_graph.cycle_result: Any forward reference, self-reference, dangling reference, or cycle fails closed.

stage_a.name: SOURCE_ADMISSION
required_prerequisites: The separately governed source authority activation record exists, is active, is in scope, and authorizes AUTHENTICATED_CANONICAL_INTRINSIC_SOURCE with PINNED_CANONICAL_INTRINSIC_FIELD.

The canonical source-object acquisition record exists before evidence and binds the authority activation hash, immutable source artifact, acquisition proof, version, deterministic extractor, exact locator, exact-one match, and source-object hash.

The immutable mapping evidence record exists before Stage A, validates against CANONICAL_FIELD_MAPPING_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA.json, and contains no Stage A, Stage B, field-pin, admission, conflict, or lineage back-reference.
The Stage A record references the evidence mapping_record_id and exact full evidence-record SHA-256; the evidence bytes are not changed after review.
The exact frozen target identity and target-manifest SHA-256 validate.

The exact RFC6901 pointer resolves once in the authenticated source object and its field type, canonical value hash, namespace, schema, semantics, and canonicalization profile match the evidence record.
The canonical field identity and deterministic mapping_record_id recompute from PROJECT_CANONICAL_JSON_V1 using MAPR1R1_RECORD_ID_V1.

The verifier projects the eight identity-basis members from the operative evidence fields and requires byte-for-byte equality with record_identity.identity_basis; identity_projection_matches_record is accepted only after that recomputation.
Conflict recomputation returns AUTHORITATIVE_MAPPING_PRESENT with exactly one active non-equivalent canonical field identity for the target.
No source authority, source object, extraction rule, mapping evidence record, or required governance reference is revoked, stale, superseded, unresolved, or cyclic.
prohibited_inputs: C2R1 derived comparative evidence as authority
human prose or reviewer preference as a source object
alternate-pointer trial or semantic pointer inference
a field pin or selected candidate pointer
a hash without independently authenticated authority and provenance

outputs.on_failure: A separate STAGE_A_ADMISSION_RECORD with decision.status ADMISSION_NOT_READY, the exact fail-closed disposition, stage_b_enabled false, and FIELD_PIN_NOT_EXPOSED_GATED_ON_ADMISSION

stage_b.name: FIELD_PIN_CANDIDATE_EXPOSURE_ONLY
preconditions_for_exposure: Stage A has an independently verified ADMISSION_READY record for the exact target.
The Stage B record references the exact Stage A admission hash and exact mapping evidence full hash.
The Stage B target object equals the admitted target byte-for-byte: target_index, source_binding_target_id, and target_manifest_sha256.
The R8 packet is located by the exact source path and jsonl line selector; no embedded packet ID is assumed because the existing R8 packet schema does not provide one.
packet_sha256 equals SHA-256 of the exact R8 JSONL record bytes in UTF-8, excluding only the line terminator; packet identity uses R8_PACKET_RAW_JSONL_LINE_SHA256_V1 and R8_JSONL_SOURCE_LOCATOR_V1.

The candidate object is linked exactly: candidate_object_id equals R5 candidate_object_id, R8 candidate_wrapper_object_id, and R8 wrapper_object_hash; candidate_object_sha256 is the same identity digest recomputed from the declared R5 identity basis under R5_CANDIDATE_WRAPPER_OBJECT_ID_V1, while candidate_source_object_sha256 and candidate_wrapper_record_sha256 are independently recomputed byte hashes.
The candidate object locator identifies the exact R5 wrapper record and its R8 wrapper-object fields; a missing or conflicting locator fails closed.
The candidate pointer set is copied completely from R8 candidate_scalar_pointers, each pointer/value hash/type tuple is exact, and R8_POINTER_SET_V1 recomputes a sorted unique pointer set digest.
The admitted exact RFC6901 pointer is present in that complete candidate pointer set; no pointer is added, removed, reordered semantically, or inferred.
All tuple linkage checks report true. Any mismatch produces STAGE_B_NOT_EXPOSED_CANDIDATE_LINK_MISMATCH and no Stage B exposure record.

packet_identity.raw_bytes: The exact UTF-8 bytes of the single R8 JSONL record, without a BOM and without its LF line terminator.

candidate_object_identity.equality_rule: SHA-256 of the canonical R5 identity basis equals candidate_object_id, candidate_object_sha256, R5 candidate_object_id, R8 candidate_wrapper_object_id, and R8 wrapper_object_hash byte-for-byte; otherwise exposure is not created.
candidate_object_identity.source_object_hash: R8 active_source_object_sha256 is a separate hash of the exact candidate source object bytes.

candidate_pointer_set_identity.ordering: Lexicographic by exact pointer string using UTF-16 code-unit order after validating NFC; arrays are otherwise order-sensitive.
candidate_pointer_set_identity.completeness: The set must equal the full R8 list for the selected packet, with no hidden pruning or top-k truncation.
candidate_pointer_set_identity.admitted_pointer_rule: The admitted exact pointer must be a member of the recomputed set; membership is linkage, not human selection.

tuple_linkage: mapping_record_id and mapping evidence hash equal the Stage A references.
target equals evidence target and packet target.
candidate_object_id equals the R5 and R8 object identities and candidate_object_sha256.
candidate pointer set digest and complete pointer tuples equal R8.
admitted pointer and canonical intrinsic semantics ID equal the Stage A admitted tuple.
stage_b.exposure_effect: Expose unchanged candidate material and the admitted tuple to a separate governed human field-pin review only.
explicit_prohibitions: Do not auto-select among one or more candidate pointers.
Do not set selected_canonical_pointer or selected_candidate_object_id to a non-null value.
Do not treat candidate cardinality, equal values, or a matching C2R1 pointer as approval.
Do not create a field pin from Stage A or Stage B exposure.
Do not change R7, R8, R8R1, the candidate packet, or historical decisions.
Do not execute source-auth, P0, P1, publication, or a formal experiment.

global_invariants: No Stage B exposure is permitted unless Stage A passes.
Stage A passage is necessary but not sufficient to create a field pin.
C2R1 is not authority, human prose is not source authority, and a hash alone is not authority.
Governance, source-owner authorization, and acquisition authentication remain separate required concerns.
